scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace @nexsolarix/api" "npm run dev --workspace @nexsolarix/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run dev --workspace @nexsolarix/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run dev --workspace @nexsolarix/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/api && npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run test --workspace @nexsolarix/web && npm run test --workspace @nexsolarix/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace @nexsolarix/astronomy && npm run db:seed --workspace @nexsolarix/api
